failed_conditions.quote: The problem was that serial.block() is called before serial.open() in hydro branch kobuki_driver/kobuki.cpp line 93

loudness.quote: I have a new version of mangled output - this time all is CAPTIAL LETTERS! :-)

resolution.quote:
Thus, the proposed patch is going to call serial.block() function after serial.open() in kobuki.cpp
Also, ecl serial.block() should warn user if file_descriptor is not initialized.

notes: All key claims verified. (1) Issue 272 body 'ROS log gets somehow horribly mangled ... And prevents Ctrl+C to work. Strange thing is that it happens only sometimes.' (2) Symptom comment 21840623 (bit-pirate): 'I have a new version of mangled output - this time all is CAPTIAL LETTERS! :-)' with an all-uppercase roslaunch log, ending 'Same result though - terminal get's unresponsive.' (3) Diagnosis comment 21917240 (jihoonl) verbatim: 'The problem was that serial.block() is called before serial.open() in hydro branch kobuki_driver/kobuki.cpp line 93' with the code block (block at 93, open at 95), 'In the version 0.3.9 ... the block() was called after open().', the serial_pos.hpp open() doc 'use the block(timeout_ms) and unblock() methods to alter its behaviour', and 'If block() is called without initializing serial, it uses default value for file_descriptor in serial_pos.cpp:line 320 ... tcsetattr(file_descriptor, TCSAFLUSH, &options);'. (4) Driver code at ba100858 confirmed: line 93 'serial.block(4000); // blocks by default, but just to be clear!' and line 95 'serial.open(parameters.device_port, ...)'. (5) Fix 054c753 'Merge pull request #278 ... To resolve issue 272. babo terminal' (PR #278, merged 2013-08-01). (6) E2 library-API eligible at step 6: a documented call-order precondition of ecl::Serial (block only after open) violated by the consumer; failure crosses the boundary (a peer that guarded block() against an unopened device, or a consumer that opened first, would not mangle the terminal). (7) Class 'other' correct: a call-order/initialisation precondition has no dedicated schema class; implicated elements block+open correct. (8) Loudness silent_documented + activate: no tooling diagnostic; the misuse is visible only as terminal side effects; jihoonl explicitly notes the provider gives no warning ('ecl serial.block() should warn user if file_descriptor is not initialized'). (9) Resolution 'recommended': PR merged, but the issue was closed without a comment showing the terminal problem gone at 054c753; the only working evidence is the older 0.3.9 release (open before block), a different consumer revision. No missed conditions.
